system.description:
A powerful refinement of Mist Form: you become wholly insubstantial yet keep your own visible shape, a ghost walking untouched through walls and gunfire alike.

Spend two Blood Traits; the transformation takes one turn and lasts for the rest of the night unless you choose to return. While insubstantial you remain fully visible and can still speak, are unaffected by any physical attack, and pass through walls and floors at will; gravity holds you only if you wish it, letting you sink or float at no more than walking pace. Fire and sunlight now inflict only lethal damage. You may use any Discipline that needs no physical contact or solid body, but cannot manipulate your surroundings unless you also possess the Thaumaturgy path Movement of the Mind.
